comment: All candidates share the same model, so optimizer progress dominated: B’s Adam rate gives substantially more progress over 256 steps than A/E, followed by D and low-rate Adagrad C. K1001 and K1002 supported this ordering. K1005 appropriately treated AdamW versus Adam at identical rates as a weak tie-break; E beating A is consistent with that preference but does not establish a general decoupled-decay advantage. No new tested hypothesis emerged.
